artifact_schema.checkpoint_states.npz: per checkpoint: <state_key>_Z, <state_key>_Zsamples, <state_key>_F, <state_key>_sigma, <state_key>_scalars (w0, w, var_z) -- everything needed to recompute S1, S3, Q_strict and S2 independently

protocol.attempt_policy: attempt_id is immutable and unique; a FAILED or ABANDONED attempt is never resumed or completed under the same id; a stale RUNNING attempt is not valid evidence; a new run needs a new attempt_id and new human authorization
protocol.estimand: under identical data, masks, initialization and first-eight-iteration RNG prefix, how does continuing the same L=5 stochastic MCEM procedure from iteration 8 to iteration 40 change selected K
protocol.gate_cell_selection_rule: the first replicate of the smallest scoped n, derived as min(n_grid); fixed by rule, not chosen by inspection
protocol.model_seed_formula: model_seed_base + k_true*100000 + n*1000 + replicate*100 + k_est*10 + start

P1.comparison: checkpoint 8 versus checkpoint 40, paired within replicate
P1.definition: for each (n, replicate) and each checkpoint: average S1 over the two starts for every candidate K, take the K with the largest average; tie tolerance 1e-12, ties resolved to the smallest K
P1.name: selected K by budget
reported: exact / under / over counts at each checkpoint
P1.start_disagreement: select K INDEPENDENTLY within start 1 and within start 2, then compare the two selected K. It is NOT 'the raw scores differ'

P2.definition: delta(n, r, K) = 0.5 * sum over start in {1,2} of [ S1(n, r, K, start, 40) - S1(n, r, K, start, 8) ]
P2.inference: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY. No formal test. Starts are NOT replicates. Spearman between K and the mean delta may be shown as a diagnostic; the 7 candidate K are not independent samples and no p-value is reported
P2.name: per-candidate-K S1 change from continuing the procedure
reported: replicate-level table: n, replicate, K, delta (224 rows)
summary: n, K, mean delta over the 8 replicates (28 rows)

secondary: winning margin (best minus runner-up in selector space) by checkpoint
budget-stability rates by candidate K and n at every tau
S2 and S3 versions of P1 and P2
primary_outcomes.wording: no materiality threshold is defined, so the question says CHANGES and the word 'materially' is not used

protocol.residual_confound: continuing the procedure redraws L=5 latent samples every further iteration, so additional optimization and additional Monte-Carlo variation are not separable by this design
protocol.runtime_estimate_note: operational estimate only. There is NO automatic runtime abort: runtime is not part of the estimand and must never include or exclude an individual fit. A manual or process interruption makes the WHOLE attempt FAILED or ABANDONED, with no partial analysis

runtime_locations.note: receipts and attempts live outside the tracked tree so that running them does not dirty the repository whose cleanliness is an authorization condition

status_note: NOT FROZEN. The single specification is the 'protocol' object below; it is generated from the runner contract by --emit-draft, so no second copy of any field exists anywhere. It carries no protocol_hash on purpose: a hash would look like a freeze. Freezing writes em_convergence_sensitivity_20260905_protocol.json with status FROZEN and its hash in its own commit, after which a human creates the annotated tag research-em-convergence-freeze-v1 on that commit as the trust anchor.
